24template <typename T> inline constexpr size_t simd_width_elems() noexcept {
25 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, float>)
26 return TENSORIUM_SIMD_WIDTH_F32;
27 if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, double>)
28 return TENSORIUM_SIMD_WIDTH_F64;
29 return 1;
30}

32template <typename T> inline size_t pad_simd(size_t n) noexcept {
33 const size_t w = simd_width_elems<T>();
34 if (w <= 1)
35 return n;
36 return ((n + w - 1) / w) * w;
37}

39template <typename T> struct AlignedDeleter {
40 void operator()(T *p) const noexcept {
41 ::operator delete[](p, std::align_val_t(TENSORIUM_ALIGN));
42 }
43};

45template <typename T> using aligned_unique_ptr = std::unique_ptr<T[], AlignedDeleter<T>>;
46
47template <typename T> inline aligned_unique_ptr<T> aligned_alloc_n(size_t n) {
48 return aligned_unique_ptr<T>(
49 static_cast<T *>(::operator new[](n * sizeof(T), std::align_val_t(TENSORIUM_ALIGN))));
50}

62template <typename T> struct Field3D {
63 aligned_unique_ptr<T> data;
64 Strides<T> st;

66 inline T *ptr() noexcept { return data.get(); }
67 inline const T *ptr() const noexcept { return data.get(); }

69 inline size_t idx(size_t i, size_t j, size_t k) const noexcept {
70 return i * st.sx + j * st.sy + k * st.sz;

130inline int sym6_index(int i, int j) noexcept {
131 if (i > j) {
132 int t = i;
133 i = j;
134 j = t;
135 }
136 if (i == 0 && j == 0)
137 return XX;
138 if (i == 0 && j == 1)
139 return XY;
140 if (i == 0 && j == 2)
141 return XZ;
142 if (i == 1 && j == 1)
143 return YY;
144 if (i == 1 && j == 2)
145 return YZ;
146 return ZZ;
147}

169template <typename T> inline Field3D<T> make_field(const Strides<T> &st) {
170 Field3D<T> f;
171 f.st = st;
172 const size_t N = st.nx_tot * st.ny_tot * st.nz_tot;
173 f.data = aligned_alloc_n<T>(N);
174 return f;
175}

183template <typename T> inline void halo_linear_extrapolate_full(Field3D<T> &f, const GridDims &D) {
184 const size_t nxTot = D.nx + 2 * D.ng;
185 const size_t nyTot = D.ny + 2 * D.ng;
186 const size_t nzTot = D.nz + 2 * D.ng;
187
188 const size_t I0 = D.ng;
189 const size_t I1 = D.ng + D.nx;
190 const size_t J0 = D.ng;
191 const size_t J1 = D.ng + D.ny;
192 const size_t K0 = D.ng;
193 const size_t K1 = D.ng + D.nz;
194
195 auto get = [&](size_t i, size_t j, size_t k) -> T { return f.ptr()[f.idx(i, j, k)]; };
196 auto set = [&](size_t i, size_t j, size_t k, T val) { f.ptr()[f.idx(i, j, k)] = val; };
197
198 for (size_t j = 0; j < nyTot; ++j)
199 for (size_t k = 0; k < nzTot; ++k) {
200 const T v_in = get(I0, j, k);
201 const T v_next = get(I0 + 1, j, k);
202 const T slope_low = v_in - v_next;
203 for (size_t s = 1; s <= D.ng; ++s)
204 set(I0 - s, j, k, v_in + slope_low * static_cast<T>(s));
205
206 const T v_hi = get(I1 - 1, j, k);
207 const T v_prev = get(I1 - 2, j, k);
208 const T slope_high = v_hi - v_prev;
209 for (size_t s = 1; s <= D.ng; ++s)
210 set(I1 - 1 + s, j, k, v_hi + slope_high * static_cast<T>(s));
211 }
212
213 for (size_t i = 0; i < nxTot; ++i)
214 for (size_t k = 0; k < nzTot; ++k) {
215 const T v_in = get(i, J0, k);
216 const T v_next = get(i, J0 + 1, k);
217 const T slope_low = v_in - v_next;
218 for (size_t s = 1; s <= D.ng; ++s)
219 set(i, J0 - s, k, v_in + slope_low * static_cast<T>(s));
220
221 const T v_hi = get(i, J1 - 1, k);
222 const T v_prev = get(i, J1 - 2, k);
223 const T slope_high = v_hi - v_prev;
224 for (size_t s = 1; s <= D.ng; ++s)
225 set(i, J1 - 1 + s, k, v_hi + slope_high * static_cast<T>(s));
226 }
227
228 for (size_t i = 0; i < nxTot; ++i)
229 for (size_t j = 0; j < nyTot; ++j) {
230 const T v_in = get(i, j, K0);
231 const T v_next = get(i, j, K0 + 1);
232 const T slope_low = v_in - v_next;
233 for (size_t s = 1; s <= D.ng; ++s)
234 set(i, j, K0 - s, v_in + slope_low * static_cast<T>(s));
235
236 const T v_hi = get(i, j, K1 - 1);
237 const T v_prev = get(i, j, K1 - 2);
238 const T slope_high = v_hi - v_prev;
239 for (size_t s = 1; s <= D.ng; ++s)
240 set(i, j, K1 - 1 + s, v_hi + slope_high * static_cast<T>(s));
241 }
242}
